fields.description: Issue of Miami Life dated February 2, 1935 (Vol. 9, No. 20). Front-page editorial discusses South Florida’s economic and political grievances, the tourist season, and criticism of gambling interests tied to Palm Beach figures and Hialeah racing. Includes commentary on Mayor E. G. ("Ev") Sewell, city governance, and calls for reform. Contains extensive local columns ("Round the Town"), editor’s mail/letters (including an account of an alleged taxi-cab assault and criticism of police response), and numerous advertisements and promotions related to Miami and Miami Beach nightlife, restaurants, and racing tip services ("Jockey Jimmy" reports) centered on Hialeah Park.
